snippet.title: High Fructose - Brutal Indies Unleashed Steam Festival
snippet.description:
🍓 Step into a high-speed, first-person fruitocalypse where ninja animals battle monstrous produce in explosive, over-the-top waves of action.
Play as the fearless Fox or unlock new heroes, collect ingredients, and unleash devastating recipes to survive the chaos.
🌀 Key Features:

Lightning-Fast FPS Combat

Ninja Combat , Auto-firing weapons and Tactical Counters

Craftable Recipes that Change the Battlefield

Unique Abilities for Each Character

⚔️ Slice. Dash. Conquer. The fruit fight is on — are you juiced up enough to survive?

🔗 Follow Us for Updates:
🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2506550/High_Fructose/
📘 Facebook:https://www.facebook.com/groups/highfructose
🐦 Twitter: https://x.com/canterochris
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/playchazakgames/
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/xKen5Ey9z6

🔔 Stay tuned for dev updates, gameplay reveals, and behind-the-scenes action from High Fructose!
#HighFructoseGame #FPSRoguelite #IndieGame #ChazakGames
